name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
description: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) is India's premier aerospace and defense PSU under the Ministry of Defence. Holding a virtual monopoly in domestic military aircraft and helicopter manufacturing, HAL designs, builds, and overhauls fighter jets (Tejas LCA), combat helicopters (Prachand LCH), trainer aircraft, and military aero-engines.

company_profile.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) is India's premier aerospace and defense PSU under the Ministry of Defence. Holding a virtual monopoly in domestic military aircraft and helicopter manufacturing, HAL designs, builds, and overhauls fighter jets (Tejas LCA), combat helicopters (Prachand LCH), trainer aircraft, and military aero-engines.

revenue_breakup.desc: Production of Tejas Mk1A, Su-30MKI, Light Combat Helicopters, and trainer aircraft.
Lifecycle airframe overhauls, engine retrofits, avionics upgrades, and ground support equipment.
Satellite launch vehicle structures for ISRO and engine sub-assemblies.

company_profile.geographic_mix: Domestic (Indian Armed Forces - IAF, Navy, Army, Coast Guard): 98% • International Exports: 2%
moats_and_strengths: Monopoly position as the sole indigenous manufacturer of military fighter jets and combat helicopters in India.
Massive order book surpassing ₹94,000 Cr, ensuring over 3.2x book-to-bill revenue visibility.
Strategic beneficiary of India's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' defense indigenization and positive indigenization lists.
Debt-free PSU balance sheet with high cash reserves (>₹20,000 Cr) and RoCE exceeding 28%.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Confirmed Order Book: ₹94,000 Cr+ with mega orders in pipeline for 97 additional Tejas Mk1A & 156 LCH helicopters

promoter_governance.parent_group: Government of India (71.64% Navratna Defense PSU)

bullish_triggers: Formal signing of contract for 97 additional Tejas Mk1A fighter aircraft worth ~₹65,000 Cr.
Transfer of technology (ToT) deal with GE Aerospace for co-production of F414 jet engines in India.
Export contract breakthroughs for Dhruv ALH and Tejas LCA with friendly foreign nations.
bearish_risks: Delays in delivery of imported GE F404 aero engines impacting Tejas Mk1A assembly timelines.
Budgetary allocation constraints in Indian defense capital acquisition outlays.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
